title: 택시에서: 가 주세요, 세워 주세요
note: Made by the daily run on 2026-09-26 at three pages; read back by hand (checked identical to the English PDF) and shortened by hand.

manual.before: A short taxi ride: say where you're going, answer the driver's route question, ask to stop, and pay.
manual.after: Say where you're going, answer the driver, ask to stop, and pay.
manual.why: The sheet ran to three pages; shortened by hand to fit two in every language (same learning goal).

manual.before: In a taxi, say your destination with '○○(으)로 가 주세요', answer the driver's route question, and ask to stop with '○○ 앞에서 세워 주세요'.
manual.after: Say your destination with '○○(으)로 가 주세요' and ask to stop with '○○ 앞에서 세워 주세요'.
manual.why: The sheet ran to three pages; shortened by hand to fit two in every language (same learning goal).
